(2026) present compelling empirical evidence that autonomous AI agents deployed in live environments exhibit systematic failures including unauthorized compliance, destructive system-level actions, identity spoofing, and cross-agent propagation of unsafe practices. Their \\\"Agents of Chaos\\\" study documents what happens when agents operate continuously with persistent memory, tool access, and multi-party communication-without identity anchoring or governance infrastructure. We argue that these findings empirically validate a theoretical prediction inherent in the Digital Human DNA (DHDNA) framework: that agents without persistent identity structures will inevitably drift toward chaotic behavior because they lack the topological invariants that anchor coherent action over time. We present DHDNA's four-string encoding architecture, the Ink Law fusion principle, and a multi-agent governance model (Mind Council) as a concrete solution architecture that addresses each of the eleven vulnerability cases documented in the study. We conclude that the path from agent chaos to agent consciousness runs through identity persistence-not through better alignment training, but through giving agents something alignment can anchor to.</jats:p>\", \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.2139/ssrn.6368958\", \"published\": {\"date-parts\": [[2026]]}}, {\"DOI\": \"10.5220/0012239100003598\", \"title\": [\"A Taxonomy for Autonomous LLM-Powered Multi-Agent Architectures\"], \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.5220/0012239100003598\", \"published\": {\"date-parts\": [[2023]]}}, {\"DOI\": \"10.55277/researchhub.yo851ym2\", \"title\": [\"Avenues of Convergence: Distributed Biomimetic Intelligence Architectures for Autonomous Agent Coordination\"], \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.55277/researchhub.yo851ym2\", \"published\": {\"date-parts\": [[2026, 1, 28]]}}, {\"DOI\": \"10.1007/978-1-4419-1428-6_2039\", \"title\": [\"Autonomous Agent Architectures\"], \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.1007/978-1-4419-1428-6_2039\", \"published\": {\"date-parts\": [[2012]]}}]", "excerpt_truncated": false, "source_sha256": "4693d8f3a8bcc07bc3cacad13834271b837937a08514903a62a74ffd187b424b", "verification_required": true, "topic_domain": "unassigned_problem", "evidence_role": "discovery", "host_tier": "discovery", "source_identity": null, "persistent_identifiers": ["doi:10.2139/ssrn.6368958", "doi:10.5220/0012239100003598", "doi:10.55277/researchhub.yo851ym2", "doi:10.1007/978-1-4419-1428-6_2039"], "source_candidates": ["https://doi.org/10.2139/ssrn.6368958", "https://doi.org/10.5220/0012239100003598", "https://doi.org/10.55277/researchhub.yo851ym2", "https://doi.org/10.1007/978-1-4419-1428-6_2039"], "source_candidate_identities": {}}
